Review Context.dev?

Reviewers describe Context.dev as a fast, reliable web-fetch and enrichment layer that is simple to integrate and especially useful for AI agents. Users say it turns web data into cleaner, more usable output for meeting prep and other agent workflows. Makers of OpenSEO and Migma AI say it handles JavaScript-heavy sites well, performs better than alternatives for speed and result quality, and avoids extra scraper, proxy, and cleanup work. Main criticisms are limited: docs could use more examples, brand color extraction needs refinement, and compliance visibility around site policy changes is unclear.

Review Context.dev?

Reviewers describe Context.dev as fast, reliable, and unusually easy to integrate, especially for AI agents that need clean web data without maintaining scraping infrastructure. They repeatedly praise the quality of its structured or markdown-ready output, brand and company enrichment, and support for use cases like meeting prep, onboarding, audits, and profile enrichment. Makers of OpenSEO, Migma AI, and DocsAlot also highlight dependable rendering, strong result quality, and simple setup. Critiques are limited to wanting fuller docs, sharper brand-color extraction, and clearer compliance visibility when sites change rules.

### Context.dev - One API to scrape, enrich, and extract the internet

Context.dev is the web context API for AI products and agents. Scrape any URL, crawl sites, turn pages into LLM-ready Markdown, extract structured data into your own schema, capture screenshots, and retrieve logos, colors, fonts, styleguides, company data, and transaction enrichment through one API. YC-backed, no card required, and built so developers or coding agents can integrate in minutes.
